name: The Circuit Rebels Blog
description: Clear explanations of how robots sense, think and act, and how to teach it with free lessons and class games.
facts: Circuit Rebels is a free, browser-based robotics program for grades 5 to 8, made in New York City by Duron Epps. Students learn how machines sense, think and act through 5-minute lessons and class games. No student accounts are needed to play, and it runs on Chromebooks.

author.name: Duron Epps
author.bio: Duron Epps made Circuit Rebels. He is a CUNY York College alumnus and a former robotics team software lead, and he teaches robotics on Saturdays in New York City.
